purpose: Third permanent-unlock research pass: current Necromancy talent progression and combat-relevant Archaeology relic acquisition. The planner should model these as progression systems with League overrides, not as a flat best-in-slot list.

policy.ground_truth: Current RuneScape Wiki pages and current 2026 Jagex material for changed game facts.
policy.pvme: Used to discover the categories and candidate unlocks. PvME values are not promoted when a current source differs or is newer.
policy.league_overlay: Base-game soul, quest, archaeology, qualification and item gates remain separate from Equilibrium passives, auto-completed quests and region exceptions.
policy.region_rule: Historical Catalyst locality labels are useful planner precedent but are not Equilibrium confirmation. Cross-region acquisition chains remain cross-region instead of being assigned to the final turn-in location.

necromancy.name: Well of Souls talent progression

talent_points.earned_from: Necromancy and Defence experience gained while using Necromancy in combat; ritual, quest-reward and other-style experience does not count.

quest_gates.purpose: Required to make/use necrotic runes and for the tier-3 Threads of Fate branch.
Required for Greater Bone Shield, Life Transfer, Darkness and Invoke Death.

necromancy.league_treatment: Equilibrium can multiply souls from rituals and can auto-complete quests. Apply those as separate modifiers to this base tree; do not rewrite the underlying talent requirements or silently mark City of Um as Equilibrium-confirmed Misthalin.

archaeology.name: Combat-relevant Archaeology relic system
archaeology.energy_note: Maximum monolith energy rises with Archaeology qualifications. The 650 cap is the end-state cap; current Wiki guidance ties the final increase to level-120-era Mysterious City progression.

relics.name: Berserker's Fury
relics.effect: Deals up to 5.5% more damage as current life points fall below maximum; does not stack with Dharok's set effect.
relics.acquisition: Combine a Lock of hair from Saradominist I progression with an Amulet of the forsaken from Barrows.

relics.name: Hungry Like the Wolf
relics.required_relic: Moonrise collection reward combined with Expensive Spices
relics.effect: Food heals 100 additional base life points and no longer carries an adrenaline penalty.
relics.acquisition: Moonrise Dig Site collection reward; Moonrise requires Secrets of Amberfell in the base game.
relics.verification_note: The current Jagex Moonrise material verifies the acquisition concept and effect. Do not fill an exact Archaeology level or monolith-energy value from community discussion alone.

relics.name: Shadow's Grace
relics.effect: Reduces movement-ability cooldowns by 50%, with the relic's documented adrenaline tradeoff.
relics.acquisition: Complete Secrets of the Inquisition at the Senntisten Dig Site to receive Aurelius's Mask.

relics.name: Blessing of Het
relics.effect: Food and potions restore 10% more life points.
relics.acquisition: Eye of Het II reward in the Het's Oasis / Desert progression chain.

relics.name: Death Ward
relics.effect: Reduces damage by 5% below 50% life points and 10% below 25% life points.
relics.acquisition: Restore an Aviansie dreamcoat from Stormguard Citadel and give it to Armadyl at Armadyl's Tower to receive the Ring of Solomon.
region_pressure: kandarin: Stormguard Citadel supplies the required artefact
asgarnia: the base-game turn-in is at Armadyl's Tower south of Falador

relics.name: Fury of the Small
relics.acquisition: Combine the red hand and green skull cave paintings obtained through Warforge artefact interactions.
relics.league_treatment: Keep Warforge as a location dependency until the planner has a sourced Equilibrium locality mapping; do not force it into a region from physical-map intuition.

relics.name: Persistent Rage
relics.effect: Generates adrenaline outside combat instead of draining it.
relics.acquisition: Give two restored hellfire katars to Dagon the Gatekeeper after completing the Dagon Bye mystery at the Infernal Source.
relics.league_treatment: Treat this as an unlock candidate, not a recommendation. Other account or League passives can overlap its out-of-combat adrenaline role.

relics.name: Heightened Senses
relics.acquisition: Use the restored Kantharos cup with the Everlight beam after the Everlight mystery progression.

relics.name: Conservation of Energy
relics.effect: Regains 10% adrenaline after using an ultimate ability.
relics.acquisition: Create the Experimental Aether Reactor through Ancient Invention after reaching Howl's Workshop / Back to the Drawing Board at Stormguard Citadel.

archaeology.league_treatment: The app should model unlock availability separately from the three-slot/energy loadout constraint. League relics are a different system and must not share the same slot or energy state.
